description: Saudi residence visa from the UK to join a family member in Saudi Arabia. Medical, FCO attestation and visa in one service. Price calculator.
h1: Saudi Arabia residence visa from the UK
intro: The Saudi residence visa is for family members joining someone who lives and works in Saudi Arabia, such as a husband, wife or children. It needs a medical, a police certificate and FCO attestation before the visa is issued. We arrange all of it, and the calculator below shows your total.
eligibility: Your family member lives in Saudi Arabia on a residence permit (iqama)
They have obtained a family residence visa reference for you
You are moving to live with them in Saudi Arabia

sections.heading: What we arrange for you
sections.text:
- Medical tests and report at our partner clinic in Manchester or London
- FCO attestation of your medical report and ACRO police certificate
- Your visa application, checked and submitted to the Saudi visa centre

sections.heading: Saudi residence visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help families across the UK join relatives in Saudi Arabia. Tick the extras you need in the calculator and we'll confirm the final price before you pay.

faqs.q: Do children need a medical for a Saudi residence visa?
faqs.a: Medical and police certificate rules depend on age. We'll confirm exactly what each family member needs.
It's the UK Foreign Office (FCO) confirming your document is genuine, so Saudi Arabia will accept it.
The visa itself usually takes about 72 hours. Allow extra time for the medical, police certificate and attestation.
